feeds.title: Kerrang!
feeds.description: Kerrang! is the world's biggest-selling weekly rock music magazine, and represents a global community of musicians and fans alike. It is a staunch supporter of fresh talent and is also home to the biggest names in metal, punk and alternative music as a whole.

feeds.title: Uncut Magazine
feeds.description: Uncut Magazine is the spiritual home of great rock music. Classic interviews, in-depth new album reviews, essential news stories, live reviews, films, DVDs and much more.

feeds.title: Rock Gig Reviews
feeds.description: This site was set up by a small group of UK rock fans who started going to rock gigs in the early 80's and haven't really grown up since.Rock Gig Reviews is a blog containing rock music news, reviews of live rock gigs, albums and exclusive interviews.

feeds.title: Punktastic
feeds.description: Punktastic is a committed and dedicated group of passionate music fans that enjoy talking about punk, rock, metal, and hardcore. Punktastic is our labour of love. They try to help you discover music you wouldn't find anywhere else.

feeds.title: Louder Than War Blog
feeds.description: Louder Than War is one of the UK's fastest-growing and award-winning music and culture websites. Louder Than War is a music and counter-culture website and record label that brings you all the latest music latest rock, punk, metal, and alternative music news, album and gig reviews, news and interviews as well as covering counter-culture film, TV, and art.

feeds.title: Get Ready to ROCK Blog
feeds.description: Since 2002, this website is for classic rock. Get Ready To Rock! for the best in rock, metal & prog and all musical points in between.

feeds.title: Mad About Rock
feeds.description: I'm a guitarist & music writer. I run own site Mad About Rock. I have interviewed Chris Jericho, Papa Roach, AFI,Billy Talent,BFMV, Halestorm & more! Get Music reviews, news, posts and interviews for all things rock (including sub genres) and metal worldwide!

feeds.title: Brace for the Obscure
feeds.description: Here you will find the greatest songs of the 1960's that no one has ever heard. I'm a man of wealth and taste. It is coming up on the 20th anniversary of the start of my still ongoing quest to listen to every pop/rock/soul song released or recorded in the 'Sixties'.

feeds.title: The Soft Rock Show
feeds.description: Weekly rock show broadcast on several stations around the world and available to hear any time on Mixcloud. Keep up to date with the latest updates on the show, news, broadcast timings and more!

feeds.title: Upset Magazine
feeds.description: Upset is a monthly print magazine, website, and more, directed to the best alternative, rock, punk, metal, and more. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on rock music in the UK.
